Round173C.spectralBlock_norm_le_cost.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (η v : ι → E) : ‖spectralBlock s η v‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖(innerSL ℂ) (η i)‖ * ‖v i‖
'Round173C.spectralBlock_norm_le_cost' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Round173C.spectralBlock_cutoff_norm_le.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (η v : ι → E) (U : Submodule ℂ E) [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
  ‖spectralBlock s η v - (spectralBlock s η v).comp U.starProjection‖ ≤ cutoffCost s η v U
'Round173C.spectralBlock_cutoff_norm_le' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Round173C.spectralBlock_cutoff_decomposition.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (η v : ι → E) (U : Submodule ℂ E) [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
  spectralBlock s η v - (spectralBlock s η v).comp U.starProjection =
    spectralBlock s (fun i => η i - U.starProjection (η i)) v
'Round173C.spectralBlock_cutoff_decomposition' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Round173C.spectralBlock_cutoff_nuclear_cost_tendsto.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (η v : ι → E) (U : ℕ → Submodule ℂ E)
  [∀ (n : ℕ), (U n).HasOrthogonalProjection]
  (hstrong : ∀ i ∈ s, Tendsto (fun n => (U n).starProjection (η i)) atTop (𝓝 (η i))) :
  Tendsto (fun n => cutoffCost s η v (U n)) atTop (𝓝 0)
